lesson.title: Feel the slope: over gentle hills, around steep ones, back to the line

methods_described.no_op: the nominal command, never steering: what the walking policy does by itself
methods_described.physics_only: the rule of thumb (argmax of the objective of the physics guess); it reads the true position and heading, so it is a reference, not a blind policy
methods_described.snn: the trained spiking student's argmax candidate from the raw sensor window only

where: simulation (MuJoCo Go2World); student inference on this computer's CPU (numpy)

difficulty_rule.passage: over: the path came within half the mound radius of its centre; around: it stayed farther out and came level with the centre; not_past: farther out and never level with the centre (scorer truth, the start frame)
